passive.name: Verdict
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **24/28/32/36/40%** and Effect Hit Rate by **24/28/32/36/40%**. Increases the chance for the wearer to be attacked by enemies. When the wearer is attacked, increase their DEF by an extra **24/28/32/36/40%** until the end of the wearer's turn.

passive.name: Time Fleets Away
passive.text: The wearer is more likely to be attacked, and DMG taken is reduced by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Treasure
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by **8/10/12/14/16%**. If the wearer is attacked and has no Shield, they gain a Shield equal to **16/20/24/28/32%** of their Max HP for **2** turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every **3** turn(s). If the wearer has a Shield when attacked, the DMG they receive decreases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

weapons.name: Day One of My New Life

passive.name: At This Very Moment
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/18/20/22/24%**. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by **8/9/10/11/12%**. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: A New Round of Shuffling
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer is attacked, there is a **100/105/110/115/120%** base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to **40/50/60/70/80%** of the wearer's DEF for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: Effect RES until 30% (if running Broken Keel) > Speed > DEF% > HP% > Effect Hit Rate
tracePriority: The Strong Defend the Weak > Action Beats Overthinking > Unwavering Gallantry

entries.name: Ice-Breaking Light
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and gains 1 stack of "Magma Will."

entries.name: Ice-Breaking Light
entries.text: Consumes 4 stacks of "Magma Will" to enhance Basic ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to **135%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG to equal to **54%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Ever-Burning Amber
entries.text: Increases the Trailblazer's DMG Reduction by **50%** and gains 1 stack of Magma Will, with a **100%** base chance to Taunt all enemies for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: War-Flaming Lance
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of the Trailblazer's ATK plus **150%** of the Trailblazer's DEF to all enemies. The next Basic ATK will be automatically enhanced and does not cost Magma Will.

entries.name: Treasure of the Architects
entries.text:
Each time the Trailblazer is hit, they gain 1 stack of "Magma Will" for a max of **8** stack(s).
When "Magma Will" has no fewer than 4 stacks, the Trailblazer's Basic ATK becomes enhanced, dealing DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
When the Trailblazer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, apply a Shield to all allies that absorbs DMG equal to **6%** of the Trailblazer's DEF plus **80**. The Shield lasts for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Call of the Guardian
entries.text: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to **30%** of the Trailblazer's DEF plus **384** for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: The Strong Defend the Weak
entries.text: After using the Skill, the DMG taken by all allies decreases by **15%** for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Unwavering Gallantry
entries.text: Using Enhanced Basic ATK restores the Trailblazer's HP by **5%** of their Max HP.

entries.name: Action Beats Overthinking
entries.text: When the Trailblazer is protected by a Shield at the beginning of the turn, increases their ATK by **15%** and regenerates **5** Energy until the action is over.

entries.name: Earth-Shaking Resonance
entries.text: When the Trailblazer uses their Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 25% of the Trailblazer's DEF. When the Trailblazer uses their enhanced Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of the Trailblazer's DEF.

entries.name: Time-Defying Tenacity
entries.text: The Shield applied to all allies from the Trailblazer's Talent will block extra DMG equal to 2% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 27.

entries.name: Trail-Blazing Blueprint
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Nation-Building Oath
entries.text: At the start of the battle, immediately gains 4 stack(s) of Magma Will.

entries.name: Spirit-Warming Flame
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: City-Forging Bulwarks
entries.text: After the Trailblazer uses enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate, their DEF increases by 10%. Stacks up to 3 time(s).
